artworks.name: 大克鼎
artworks.description: 海内青铜器三宝之一，铭文290字记载西周土地制度与礼制，上博镇馆之宝之首
artworks.descriptionEN: One of the three great bronze treasures of China; its 290-character inscription records the Western Zhou land and ritual systems - the foremost treasure of the Shanghai Museum.

artworks.name: 子仲姜盘
artworks.description: 春秋早期盥洗器，造型独特，鱼蛙等水生动物装饰精美
artworks.descriptionEN: A Spring-and-Autumn wash basin with uniquely crafted, finely detailed aquatic-animal ornaments.

artworks.name: 商鞅方升
artworks.description: 战国标准量器，刻有商鞅铭文，见证秦统一度量衡的历史起点
artworks.descriptionEN: A Warring-States standard measure engraved with Shang Yang's inscription, marking the start of Qin's unification of weights and measures.

artworks.name: 见日之光镜
artworks.nameEN: Jian Ri Zhi Guang Mirror (See-the-Sunlight Mirror)
artworks.description: 西汉透光镜，日光照射时镜面文字可映于墙上，古代科技奇迹
artworks.descriptionEN: A Western-Han transparent mirror: in sunlight its inscription is cast onto the wall - an ancient technological marvel.

artworks.name: 白石供养菩萨像
artworks.description: 汉白玉雕造，唐代佛教造像巅峰之作，上博十大镇馆之宝之一
artworks.descriptionEN: Carved in white marble, a pinnacle of Tang Buddhist sculpture and one of the museum's Ten Treasures.

artworks.name: 高逸图卷
artworks.description: 唐代仅存的人物画孤品，竹林七贤残卷，国宝级文物
artworks.descriptionEN: The only surviving figure painting of the Tang dynasty - a fragment of the 'Seven Sages of the Bamboo Grove' - a national-treasure artifact.

artworks.name: 雪竹图轴
artworks.description: 传世名迹，雪竹意境深远
artworks.descriptionEN: A renowned extant masterpiece, profound in its imagery of bamboo in snow.

artworks.name: 王羲之草书上虞帖卷
artworks.nameEN: Wang Xizhi - Cursive Letter to Shangyu
artworks.description: 书圣王羲之草书名迹，中国书法史最重要的传世作品之一
artworks.descriptionEN: A cursive masterwork by the Sage of Calligraphy, Wang Xizhi - among the most important surviving works in Chinese calligraphy history.

artworks.name: 王献之行书鸭头丸帖卷
artworks.nameEN: Wang Xianzhi - Duck Head Pill Letter
artworks.description: 王献之传世行书名作，纵26.1cm横26.9cm，绢本
artworks.descriptionEN: A celebrated running-script work by Wang Xianzhi, 26.1 x 26.9 cm, on silk.

artworks.name: 怀素草书苦笋帖卷
artworks.nameEN: Huaisu - Cursive Letter on Bitter Bamboo Shoots
artworks.description: 唐代狂草大师怀素传世名迹
artworks.descriptionEN: A surviving cursive masterwork by Huaisu, the Tang master of wild cursive script.

artworks.name: 人形玉神像
artworks.description: 4000多年前的玉器神人像，良渚文化代表性玉器
artworks.descriptionEN: A jade deity figure from over 4,000 years ago, a representative Liangzhu-culture jade.

artworks.name: 绿釉鹦鹉形杯
artworks.nameEN: Green-glazed Cup in Shape of Parrot
artworks.description: 唐代绿釉精品，鹦鹉造型生动
artworks.descriptionEN: A fine Tang green-glazed piece, vividly shaped as a parrot.
